topic: Responsive UI Implementation from Figma to Code
learningObjectives: Translate Figma layouts into reusable frontend components.
Apply responsive design principles across different screen sizes.
Maintain visual consistency between designs and implemented interfaces.

activities.title: Design-to-Code Map
activities.instruction: Map Figma elements to frontend implementation choices.

content.concept: Design-to-code work translates visual layouts, components, spacing, typography, and interactions into reusable frontend structures.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Responsive Layout Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust the layout across different viewport sizes.

content.concept: Responsive interfaces adapt layouts, dimensions, and component behavior to different screen sizes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component Mapping
activities.instruction: Match design elements with reusable code components.

content.concept: Reusable frontend components can represent repeated patterns from a design system and reduce duplicated implementation work.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Responsive Page Builder
activities.instruction: Build a responsive page from design components.

content.concept: A responsive page combines reusable components, flexible layouts, appropriate breakpoints, and consistent design tokens.
